summary: Brera Holdings PLC, now operating as Solmate Infrastructure PLC (NASDAQ: SLMT), furnished a Form 6-K on September 21, 2026, attaching a press release announcing management participation in a live panel at the Solana Capital Forum Singapore on October 6, 2026, during TOKEN2049 week. The release highlights a treasury estimated at roughly $141 million as of September 18, 2026, versus about $88 million in July, a rise exceeding 60%, though values are unaudited point-in-time estimates. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed; this is a routine event-notice filing with no special-situation mechanics to arbitrage.
